title: A Human-Like Pedestrian Model for Automated Driving Simulations
summary: Automated vehicles must be able to interact with pedestrians safely and efficiently across diverse traffic situations. Although driving simulators offer a scalable testbed for learning such capabilities, existing theory-inspired pedestrian models are narrow in scope and limited to go/no-go crossing decisions in single-lane settings.
